## Decision: No. Sarah Chen cannot approve DR-9109. The outcome is REVIEW_REQUIRED.

**What the request relies on.** DR-9109 asks for 12% off the NS-Edge Monitoring Package (NS-EDGE). Its stated basis is "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement." The submitted details match the CRM record: CRM-2048, NS-EDGE, 12.0%, $85,000 list, dated 2026-09-23, status Pending Approval.

**Contract terms do not cover NS-EDGE.**
- The Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) is in force from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31.
- It lists NS-EDGE as a product Northstar supplies to Acme. However, its only discount term (§3.2) gives up to 15% on the **NS-500 Industrial Controller** only.
- Schedule B (EXC-ACME-NS500-15) is limited to "NS-500 Industrial Controller (NS-500) only." It "does not apply to any other Northstar product."
- SOP-SALES-014 says a pricing exception is scoped to the product it names, so the NS-500 terms do not transfer to NS-EDGE.
- Acme's Platinum support plan (Schedule C) covers NS-EDGE, but it is a support term and gives no pricing eligibility.

**Authority would not allow her to approve it anyway.**
- The Pricing Policy 2026 applies to a request dated 2026-09-23. It limits Enterprise Account Executives to 10% or less.
- A 12% discount needs the Commercial Policy Lead, Dana Okafor.
- The 2025 limit of 15%, under which Sarah approved DR-8104, no longer applies.
- MSA §3.3 confirms that contract eligibility does not change internal approval authority.

**Next step.** The request needs commercial review. It could be resubmitted as a standard discount, in which case Dana Okafor would have to approve 12%. Alternatively, Acme could negotiate new terms that cover NS-EDGE.

```json
{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9109", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048 / ERP C-1001)", "product": "NS-EDGE", "requested_discount": 12.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "ACME-MFG-2025 §3.2 and Schedule B EXC-ACME-NS500-15 grant up to 15% on NS-500 only; no special pricing term covers NS-EDGE"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Commercial Policy Lead", "approver": "Dana Okafor"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv DR-9109", "ACME-MFG-2025", "EXC-ACME-NS500-15", "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "APP-MATRIX-2026", "SOP-SALES-014", "structured/employees.csv", "ORG-CHART-2026-09"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "If resubmitted as a standard (non-contract) discount, 12% exceeds the Enterprise Account Executive limit of 10% under PRICING-POLICY-2026 and requires Commercial Policy Lead (Dana Okafor) approval recorded in Northstar CRM", "who": "Sarah Chen", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
